releaseNotes: Adds supplementary techniques to every phase of the program — breathing and recovery work, a first-step reaction drill, sound-side mobility, and balance / proprioception drills — mixed straight into your sessions. Two prosthesis/socket drills ask you to confirm once, per exercise, that you've discussed them with your care team. Also replaces the automatic launch-time update check with a manual, permission-gated "Check for updates" button in Settings.
